why_tracked: Owns the workhorse and accessible segment, is moving upmarket into industrial SLS, and is advertising directly into drone manufacturing.
headline: Formlabs is shifting budget from LinkedIn to Google: LinkedIn down to 28 ads (from 33) as three case-study documents dropped, while Google search ads rose to 121 (from 106).
so_what: Both drone ads held steady, so the contested-ground read on drones is unchanged. The cut fell on prototyping case studies, not on production or drone messaging. [Inference] More search and less LinkedIn means Formlabs is harvesting demand ahead of Fuse X1 deliveries in Q4: buyers searching for SLS and production printing will see Formlabs first. Fuse X1 shipping is still not confirmed.

spend_method: Dollars are derived at render time by tools/spend_model.py, never stored. Ads with no disclosed impressions are reported as not disclosed, never imputed.
